vocabulary.meaning_en: to bring something closer; (a car) to stop near a place
vocabulary.example: Please pull up a chair and join us.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go to a place and take someone with you (usually by car)
vocabulary.example: I'll pick you up at your house at eight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to close a shop or business at the end of the day
vocabulary.example: We close up at six o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move something to a higher position
vocabulary.example: Lift up the box and put it on the table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something brighter; to become happier
to make someone or something wait; to delay
to make a place clean and tidy
vocabulary.note_ar: cleanup (كلمة واحدة) اسم وليس فعلًا مركّبًا
vocabulary.note_en: "A cleanup" (one word) is a noun, not a phrasal verb.

vocabulary.example: We'll take up the homework after lunch.

vocabulary.note_ar: كلمة غير مهذبة؛ الأفضل: Please be quiet
vocabulary.example: Instead of "shut up", say "please be quiet".
It dawned on me that I had left my keys at home.
Bear with me. I'll find the file in a minute.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give all your attention to something
vocabulary.example: I can't concentrate with this noise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a game with Xs and Os on a 3x3 board

fine_lines.title: clean up (verb) vs a cleanup (noun)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: clean up فعل مركّب (فعل + حرف جر). a cleanup اسم (معه أداة a) وليس فعلًا مركّبًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Clean up is a phrasal verb (verb + preposition). A cleanup is a noun (it has the article a), not a phrasal verb.

examples.sentence: There was a big cleanup in the park.

expressions.example: We're having tea. Pull up a chair!

expressions.meaning_en: I will come and take you with me at...
expressions.example: I'll pick you up at 4 o'clock.

expressions.phrase: We'll take up this conversation later.
expressions.example: It's late. We'll take up this conversation tomorrow.
Bear with me, the computer is slow.

grammar.title: Meanings of up
grammar.explanation_ar: up يمكن أن تعني: أكثر/زيادة (shoot up)، اقتراب (pull up)، تحسين (clean up, brighten up)، انتهاء (close up)، حركة للأعلى (lift up). معرفة هذه المعاني تساعدك على تخمين معنى الفعل المركّب.
grammar.explanation_en: Up can mean: more/increase (shoot up), closer (pull up), improve (clean up, brighten up), finish/end (close up), movement upward (lift up). Knowing these helps you guess a phrasal verb's meaning.
examples: The car pulled up to the house. (closer)

grammar.title: Phrasal verbs change tense like normal verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: نصرّف الفعل وليس حرف الجر: take up ← took up، pick up ← picked up، shoot up ← shot up.
grammar.explanation_en: Change the verb, not the preposition: take up → took up, pick up → picked up, shoot up → shot up.
examples: We took up the homework in the morning.
She picked me up at eight.

grammar.title: The game: Xs and Os with phrasal verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: ارسم لوحة 3×3 وضع فعلًا في كل مربع. لتأخذ المربع قل الفعل المركّب (مثل pull up) واستخدمه في جملة صحيحة. النسخة الأصعب: ضع حرف جر ورقمًا في كل مربع، واذكر ذلك العدد من الأفعال مع جمل.
grammar.explanation_en: Draw a 3x3 board with a verb in each square. To win a square, say the phrasal verb (e.g. pull up) and use it correctly in a sentence. Harder version: put a preposition and a number in each square, and give that many phrasal verbs with sentences.
examples: Square "pick": I'll pick you up at your house. ✔
Square "up 4": pull up, close up, take up, clean up + four sentences.

questions.question: "Please pull up a chair" means ___.
choices: bring a chair closer and sit with us

questions.question: "I'll pick you up at eight." means ___.
choices: I will come and take you with me.
I will wait for you at work.
questions.explanation_en: Pick someone up = come and take them.
